faq.question: Why does the dashboard show 42 files but my repo has 40k+ files?
faq.answer: The gate scans configured mock/sample paths (~42 JSON files on ai-platform). Repo file count is an explorer inventory for context — Simplebeacon does not fiction-scan every file in node_modules or the full monorepo unless you scope a scan there.

faq.question: What is the difference between quality and consistency scores?
faq.answer: Quality score is a capped mock-scan heuristic (often 99%). Consistency score reflects fiction/KPI checks on page samples — use consistency on Dashboard and Compliance Audit for accurate pass/fail.

faq.question: Why does Results show 0 issues?
faq.answer: Gate PASS with zero issues on configured paths is correct for ai-platform. Results filters rawIssues from the latest scan — an empty list means a clean deterministic scan, not a broken page.

faq.question: Why does my dashboard still show old numbers after an update?
faq.answer: Hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), restart the dashboard server, and clear stale localStorage keys (cascadeAuthToken, simplebeaconRecentAssessments, last*Model). Re-run scan to refresh .simplebeacon/report.json.

faq.question: What is repository-audit?
faq.answer: A dataSource flag on sample JSON meaning metrics come from this repo (tests, file counts, git state) — not fictional SaaS telemetry.

faq.question: How do I run tests?
faq.answer: From ai-platform/: npm test. Filter with --testPathPattern=page-samples or -t "help" for a single page.

faq.question: Why is coverage shown as — on Coverage Reports?
faq.answer: Default npm test uses --no-coverage. Jest pass rate (936/936) is measured; Istanbul line/branch % are not collected unless enabled in CI.

faq.question: Where do dashboard pages load data from?
faq.answer: Most pages fetch web/data/*-sample.json via stub API (/api/*). ~5 pages have live backends; the rest use dashboard-stub-api.js snapshots.

faq.question: Is unbreakable-oracle a real model?
faq.answer: No — it was demo fiction in sample JSON. The active local model is agi-chatbot-test (~4.1GB). New baselines use platform-checklist.
